note.p: See Ed Pope: Branston was probably Robert Branston 1778-1827 in DNB Branston family, engravers, who perhaps made some wood engravings for the Godwins' Juvenile Library. His address in Holdens directory 1811 was East India Chambers, Leadenhall-st. The only other Branstons in London in Holdens 1811 were a baronet, an Esq, a Mrs, a shoemaker and a cabinetmaker. In the following list, we have included all Bramston entries in square brackets in case this was Godwin's spelling mistake. The only Bramstons in London in Holdens 1811 were a barrister John Bramston, and John William Simcoe Bramston 1758-1818 of Somerset-pl, Auditor of the Duchy of Lancaster and Commissioner of Appeals in the Excise.
